title: Ernst Mach Grant (Worldwide)
provider: OeAD - Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
description: Grant for students, graduates and researchers from outside the EU to complete a study period, a full master's programme or a research stay at an Austrian university or university of applied sciences.
amount: EUR 1,150 per month plus accident and health insurance and, in some cases, accommodation and travel support

title: Ernst Mach Grant - ASEA-UNINET
provider: OeAD - Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
description: Ernst Mach Grant line for nationals of Southeast Asian partner countries in the ASEA-UNINET network to carry out doctoral or post-doctoral research at an Austrian university.
amount: EUR 1,150 per month plus insurance and, in some cases, travel and accommodation support

title: ISTA PhD Programme Fellowships
provider: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
field: Biology, neuroscience, computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, earth and climate science
description: Fully funded, English-language graduate school at a research institute near Vienna, admitting students with a bachelor's or master's degree into an interdisciplinary PhD with rotations.
amount: Employment contract with a competitive salary (around EUR 32,000-38,000 per year), social insurance and research funding

title: Vienna BioCenter PhD Programme Fellowships
field: Molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry, structural biology, neuroscience, computational biology
description: International doctoral programme run jointly by research institutes and universities on the Vienna BioCenter campus, with two recruitment calls per year and fully funded positions.
amount: Employment contract with a salary set by the Austrian Science Fund scheme, plus social insurance

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Austria-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Austrian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
